ArcaniaBot in exactly 2k characters:
It's a bot we made, specifically for season 4, to handle some stuff automatically, and to provide some utilities for DMs, mods, and players.

What is it that DMs and mods get to do? Don't worry about it.
I'll just let you know that DMs prepared some things for the bot to announce at some points in time. Keep an eye for those.

Commands for the players are as follows:
`?help` - shows the list of commands. Kinda like this channel but more detailed and elsewhere. `?help commandname` will give details on that command.

`?time` - displays current local time for the game. All times in the game are affixed to the US/Pacific timezone. America/Los_Angeles for timezone nerds.

`?where` - shows in which IC channel someone was last active. Call it with the target's nickname (full or just beginning), or username, or mention - all these would work on me:
- ?where Roy
- ?where versil
- ?where <@!148682928434577408>
If someone was gone for more than a day, they won't show up here, neither will DMs and bots.

`?stocks` - lets you interact with the stocks of Empire City companies. By itself the command shows the stock prices.
`?stocks mine` shows how many you have for each company. 
`?stocks buy company_code stock_amount` and `?stocks sell company_code stock_amount` do what they sound like, for the specific `company_code` (3-5 letters) and `stock_amount`. Remember the transactions are public, and that **AB has no integration with Avrae or DND Beyond, so you need to update your money on your character sheet after you buy/sell stocks.** The bot will do the math for you.

Commands can be used in any channel and by private message, and currently have no cooldowns. I hope I won't have to add restrictions to either, but I will if needed. Remember that the `?help` command may give you more details. For things not covered there or here, or any observed errors, please let me know.

This may be edited or expanded if new commands get added during the season.

FYI: this channel is for requesting help regarding ArcaniaBot - whether something isn't working for you and you want to report it, and for new features and such to be announced. As Mariam said, please keep testing commands to bot-commands, and Avrae usage where applicable to <#850783816267071488> . New feature in fact coming soon, once it's past testing.

New little feature for yall:
Call `?longrest` and 8 hours (and up to 5 minutes for technical reasons) later the bot will remind you your long rest has passed, in the same channel where you tapped out for the night (or day for anyone more nocturnal) so you won't forget where you called it a day if you weren't in your cozy sloop.
Note that AB has no integration with Beyond or Avrae, so this does not call Av's long rest command and does not refresh your abilities in any way. This just does what you can see there.

not pinging all players, but I hope this won't be glanced over
with a new feature added, I had to remake how AB stores its data.

for those currently online, `?where` might give weird outputs first used, this should clear itself out next time the target speaks IC.

there *might* be oddities regarding long rest notifications. AB pings me on errors in the logic, but might not if the logic is sound but produces wrong result - if you notice that your `?longrest` command isn't being processed right, or that you don't get your notification 8h later, please send me a private message or ping me here.

I'll mention the new feature either after I make sure all previous features still work as intended, or if the new feature happens to pop up on its own.

alright, looks like it's working after four hours of fixing, so here's the official announcement:

**We are making the use of the `?longrest` command required to mark the start of your long rest.**
It will continue working the same way as before, pinging you after 8 hours.
But, in addition to that, in the <#865915890846531595> channel, you (and DMs) will be pinged:
- 16 hours after the end of your last long rest, as a warning
- 20 hours after the end of your last long rest, **to announce you are gaining a level of exhaustion**
- every 24 hours after that point, **to announce you are gaining another level of exhaustion**

People who have not been online in the last 24 hours **are exempt from this**. It only checks for those who have been playing and not resting.

Those who took a rest after being warned/struck with exhaustion, starting a long rest will reset that counter, but exhaustion works as normal, still. **The bot does not track your *total* exhaustion.**
If you have reasons to believe something went wrong and you should not have gotten a warning or penalty, DMs are now armed with a way to manually reset your warning/penalty counters.

Later today I'll add two more things:
- a `?shortrest` command requested by a few people, which will just do the delayed ping
- both `?longrest` and `?shortrest` will have AB tell you the corresponding Avrae commands in its reply to your command use

Welcome to Empire City.
Give us hammocks, or give us a bed.

update:
- `?shortrest` is now implemented. works as you expect, except the timer on the ping is one hour.
- when calling `?longrest` and `?shortrest`, AB will point you to Avrae's commands - `!game lr` and `!game sr`, so you don't forget
- an edge case that we found thanks to Noodles was fixed - if you're away for more than 24 hours, on your return you'll be reminded of this mechanic, and your warning counter will be reset to when you came back - so you have 16/20 hours from that point, not from your last long rest whenever that happened to be in the past

psa yall: something did break overnight, and you might not have gotten your pings for finishing your long rest from the command. I'll fix that in a bit, and if anyone gets a long rest warning until then: if I react to it with <:dontworryaboutit:862375966198464522> , it's incorrect and getting fixed. if <:stoppostingandsleep:862363897134710784> , it's a valid warning

As requested by Ebuc and tested by Mazie to find I messed up on the first try, there is now a subcommand `?longrest left` which will output how long you have left on your current long rest, so you can know when Malathor will pay you a visit.
Sweet dreams. I hope you like sandwiches.

Quick update: originally the `?stocks` command was built so it could be used anywhere, and then the transactions would be reported at <#852796853501427732> for everyone to see. But, as everyone has been going there IC to call the commands there, the automatic messages are removed, and instead `?stocks buy` and `?stocks sell` can only be used at <#852796853501427732>. `?stocks` (for prices) and `?stocks mine` (for your portfolio) are not restricted to any location, but feel free to use them in that channel too if you're there IC.

New stuff:
- `?longrest` tracks channels even better. In addition to that, if you go IC to another IC channel while you're resting, you'll get a warning. If you do it again, it'll be counted as interrupting your long rest, with all the usual things that happen like AB shouting at you hours later
- you can also manually decide to interrupt your long rest without doing the spamming elsewhere by `?longrest stop` (or `?longrest cancel` or `?longrest interrupt`, pick whichever's easiest to remember)
- also speaking of long rests, during the intermission the warnings for missing your long rests are switched off, and in a bit I'll switch off the notifications for people coming back from a 24h+ hiatus. Using `?longrest` is still active, if you feel like doing that
- new command: `?timer` lets you set up a custom timer. `?shortrest` is still there working as a timer fixed at 1h
?help timer

?timer
`?timer <duration> [optionally text]`

Set up an arbitrary timer, for the bot to ping you like with short rest.
You specify how many minutes or hours as the duration argument:
- if it's just a number, it's minutes
- for hours, do e.g. `3h`
- for mixed hours and minutes do e.g. `1h15m` or `1h15`
Maximum time is 8h (480 minutes).

With the signal for intermission to be over, AB resumes checking long rests. Everyone was manually set to have their long rest start time at 16:00 yesterday server time, and end at midnight. Tracking everyone from two weeks back was a bit much. If you're going off now, use ~~!longrest~~ ?longrest to not get notified unnecessarily. If you've already gone to sleep and get this discrepancy, let me know later.
